records.title: Locally Confident, Globally Stuck: The Quality-Exploration Dilemma in Diffusion Language Models
records.reason: The primary abstract is about decoding-sample exploration and answer quality; it does not identify an inference latency, memory, throughput, or serving-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Layer-wise Token Compression for Efficient Document Reranking
records.reason: The method reduces inference work in cross-encoder document reranking and reports higher QPS, a direct serving-throughput contribution.

records.title: Full Attention Strikes Back: Transferring Full Attention into Sparse within Hundred Training Steps
records.reason: This transfers full-attention behavior into sparse attention for LLM inference and reports both prefill and decode acceleration.

records.title: Keep What Audio Cannot Say: Context-Preserving Token Pruning for Omni-LLMs
records.reason: Inference-time multimodal token pruning reduces model input work while preserving reported task quality, a direct efficiency path for an Omni-LLM.

records.title: Generative IoT: advancing IoT with generative AI and large language models
records.reason: This is a review rather than a new runtime method, but its primary publisher abstract directly connects LLM/GenAI IoT deployments with edge execution and inference-time, scalability, and energy constraints.

records.title: LiftQuant: Continuous Bit-Width LLM via Dimensional Lifting and Projection
records.reason: Continuous low-bit weight quantization reduces LLM deployment memory and makes larger models fit constrained GPU memory.

records.title: PR2: Predictive Routing Replay for MoE-Based LLM Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: The primary abstract concerns MoE reinforcement-learning training stability and replay; it does not describe inference-time routing or serving efficiency.

records.title: Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Parallel Decoding for Diffusion-Based Multimodal Large Language Models
records.reason: It changes the inference-time decoding path for multimodal diffusion LLMs and manages runtime cost while improving visual information selection. The abstract does not claim a throughput speedup; full-text sections confirm fixed scheduling, no extra model forward pass, and near-baseline throughput. Body review: VRCD reranks parallel-decoding tokens using visual complementarity. The fixed commit schedule adds no model forward pass; stated post-processing is O(MN + M²N), and measured throughput remains near baseline. The reported gains are mainly output quality, not a speedup.

records.title: Layer Collapse in Diffusion Language Models
records.reason: The layer-collapse analysis has direct implications for sparse/low-bit inference deployment; its abstract supplies an empirical quantization result relevant to compression trade-offs.

records.title: How to Compress KV Cache in RL Post-Training? Shadow Mask Distillation for Memory-Efficient Alignment
records.reason: KV-cache compression for LLM rollouts is within inference-memory scope. The authors withdrew this version for experimental errors, so its reported results are not reliable evidence of effectiveness; acceptance here records topic relevance only.

records.title: FlashSampling: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Sampling
records.reason: The method changes the LM-head sampling runtime and reduces memory/communication overhead in LLM generation, with a reported serving latency gain.

records.title: StableQAT: Stable Quantization-Aware Training at Ultra-Low Bitwidths
records.reason: Although quantization-aware training is part of the method, the primary abstract explicitly targets low-bit deployed LLMs and their inference memory/latency constraints.

records.title: xGR: Efficient Generative Recommendation Serving at Scale
records.reason: This is a serving architecture for generative recommendation with explicit prefill/decode and KV-cache management, and it reports a throughput improvement.

records.title: AdaPLD: Adaptive Retrieval and Reuse for Efficient Model-Free Speculative Decoding
records.reason: It reduces target-model work in speculative LLM decoding and reports an inference speedup.

records.title: Veda: Scalable Video Diffusion via Distilled Sparse Attention
records.reason: The abstract targets video diffusion generation rather than language-model inference, serving, or inference-time compression in the project scope.

records.title: QAM-W: Joint 2D Codebook Quantization for LLM Weights via Hadamard Rotation and Activation-Aware Scaling
records.reason: This is a direct LLM weight-compression method for lower-memory inference deployment, with a reported compression/quality comparison.

records.title: Evaluating CUDA Tile for AI Workloads on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs
records.reason: This evaluates GPU kernel/runtime performance on AI and LLM inference workloads and reports attention-kernel results, directly relevant to inference execution efficiency.

records.title: NI Sampling: Accelerating Discrete Diffusion Sampling by Token Order Optimization
records.reason: The contribution is an inference-time sampling schedule for diffusion LLMs with a reported sampling speedup.

records.title: MemoSight: Unifying Context Compression and Multi Token Prediction for Reasoning Acceleration
records.reason: It reduces context/KV memory and accelerates reasoning-model inference through compression and multi-token prediction.

records.title: Sequential KV Cache Compression via Probabilistic Language Tries: Beyond the Per-Vector Shannon Limit
records.reason: The method directly targets inference-time KV-cache memory with sequence-level compression; the abstract motivates the method through cache storage limits.
